info.summary: Pay-per-call data for Arc, Base and X1: can a token be sold, exit checks, contract powers, agent registry health, rendered web pages.
info.description: On-chain data sold per call over x402, built for agents. Arc (Circle's L1, eip155:5042): about 9 in 10 new USDC-paired Uniswap v4 launches (Argus included), each with a simulated buy-then-sell verdict (no money moves), exit checks, hook risk, deployer history, ERC-8004 agent liveness and payability. Base: exit checks (a simulated buy and full sell), gas cost in dollars, Basenames. Arc and Base: contract owner powers, one-sentence transaction explanations. X1: token, pool, trade, wallet and exit-liquidity data. Plus a real headless-Chrome page extractor. An unpaid call returns a standard x402 402 listing every rail: USDC on Arc (EIP-3009 authorization we settle, or Circle Gateway nanopayments), USDC on Base (same two), USDC on Solana, or XNT on X1. Pay the payTo that the 402 names for your network. Free discovery: /.well-known/x402 and /api/x402/discovery.
info.x-guidance:
What this is: paid GET endpoints under https://apexfaucet.xyz/api/x402/. Each returns JSON wrapped as {ok, paid, tier, data}.
How to pay: call once without payment, read the 402 (v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, v1 JSON accepts[]), pick your network, sign, repeat the call with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. On Arc and Base, Circle Gateway balances work (gasless). A call we cannot serve (missing or malformed parameter) is refused before payment.
When to call what:
- Before buying a new Arc token: /api/x402/arc-fresh ($0.003) lists recent launches, each with a sell verdict from a simulated buy-then-sell about 12 s after the pool opened (verdictAgeSeconds says how old; re-check liquidity if verdictStale) and a bundle verdict once its first two minutes are read (bundle.verdict). Polling? Pass since=<nextSince from your last answer> to get only new launches; limit=N for the newest N.
- One Arc pool, buy or not: /api/x402/arc-verdict?pool=<v4 pool id> or ?token=0x... ($0.002). Up to 25 at once: /api/x402/arc-exit-check-bulk ($0.025).
- Was a launch bundled (creator's own buy, wallets it funded buying first): /api/x402/arc-bundle?token=0x... or ?pool=... ($0.004).
- Hook risk from the hook address alone, no chain call: /api/x402/arc-hook-risk?hook=0x... ($0.003).
- Is an Arc agent alive and payable: /api/x402/arc-agent-watch ($0.004). Did a payment land: /api/x402/arc-payment?tx=0x... or /api/x402/x1-payment?sig=... ($0.003).
- Base: can you sell this token, and at what loss: /api/x402/base-exit-check/0x<token> ($0.01). Gas cost in dollars: /api/x402/base-gas ($0.001, Base only).
- Arc or Base contract, what can its owners do to holders: /api/x402/contract-flags?chain=base|arc&address=0x... ($0.004). What a transaction did: /api/x402/tx-explain?chain=base|arc&tx=0x... ($0.003).
- X1 tokens: /api/x402/token/{mint}, /holders/{mint}, /trades/{mint} ($0.003); sell-side exit check /api/x402/exit-check/{mint} ($0.004).
- Read a web page an ordinary fetch returns empty: /api/x402/page-extract?url=... ($0.009, real Chrome, JavaScript executed).
Every verdict is a measurement at a stated time, not a promise. Prices are in USD; the 402 is authoritative. Full list: /.well-known/x402.

get.summary: What a transaction on Arc ACTUALLY costs, measured from real receipts rather than quoted from the docs. The companion to /api/x402/arc-cost, which prices a named operation at the current gas price: that one is the quote, this one is the measurement and the tail. The most repeated claim about Arc is that USDC-as-gas means predictable low fees. The low half is true; the predictable half does not survive measurement, and that is what you are buying. You get the full percentile spread of cost per transaction in USDC, the cost broken down by transaction kind (contract call, plain transfer, contract deploy), the base-fee distribution with the share of blocks sitting on the 20 gwei floor, and the complete sampling method. A fee is gasUsed times effectiveGasPrice over 1e18, because USDC is the native gas token and native values carry 18 decimals - effectiveGasPrice is what was actually paid, not a bid, so these are fees and not estimates. HOW THIS COULD BE WRONG, and what we do about it: consecutive recent blocks measure one moment - twelve of them showed a base fee of exactly 20 gwei at both min and max, which reads as a fixed price, while forty blocks spread across 500,000 found six above the floor and one at 202.67 gwei. So blocks are spread across the span, transactions are taken from throughout each block rather than off the top where the highest-priority traffic sits, blocksFailed and receiptsFailed are published, and a 99th percentile is REFUSED below 200 samples because a p99 from 55 receipts is one observation wearing a statistic name. Every count is in the response; read it there, not here.

get.summary: Deep immune check for one Arc token: four readings in one call, fused into one grade. EXIT: a real buy-then-sell round trip simulated on Arc (nothing spent), the pool fee, a dynamic-fee hook, and whether a plain wallet can pull the liquidity. CLUSTER: was the launch bundled (the launcher and wallets it funded buying in the first two minutes, with their share of supply). HOLDERS: every Transfer since the first mint replayed into balances, top-10 wallets and what the creator still holds. HISTORY: what the creator launched before and how many of those carry risk flags. GRADE: A/B healthy (A clean; B fair: sells, with a cost or a caveat), C watch, D sick, F infected, ? unproven; the worst level any reading reaches, with every reason named. A reading we could not take is listed in evidence.missing and never counts as clean: one missing side reading rules out A, two or more give C at best, a sell test that did not run gives ? (and is refused before payment). Each answer carries ageSeconds (results are reused for at most 90 s). Returns the full evidence and its sha256 evidenceHash (canonical JSON, keys sorted) so you can recompute it; the same hash is shown at https://apexfaucet.xyz/arc/immune/{token}. A bad address, a token with no Arc pool or a sell test that could not run is refused before payment. 10% of every paid check is recorded as owed to a People Pot (a public ledger at https://apexfaucet.xyz/api/people-pot; the pot contract is deployed on Arc at 0xed8615da5256c6bdc6040fa6ae1d9f22070c48b7 and funded separately in small amounts, so the owed total is a ledger of what we intend to fund, and nothing has been paid to people from it yet).
